title: eurya angulosa
intro: Eurya angulosa, commonly known as the Angle-leaf Eurya or Angle-leaf Spindletree, is a plant species that belongs to the family Theaceae. It is native to the tropical regions of Asia and is widely used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Eurya angulosa include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, relieve pain, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
